markup.jesusWords: Native source wj spans take precedence. Full-verse inheritance follows the pinned KJV1769 wj source. All KJV-mixed native units have edition-specific reviewed, raw-text-hash-pinned speech spans or explicit reviewed omissions; narration is not colored.
markup.translatorAdditions: USFM add spans are preserved as [ADD] markers.
markup.footnotesAndCrossReferences: Source apparatus is excluded from display text.

headings.textSource: Localized editorial headings already shipped with the app; not publisher headings for this alternate edition.
headings.placement: Explicit per-chapter beforeVerse lookup in the alternate edition's displayed coordinates.
headings.emptyChapters: Stored as explicit empty arrays; runtime fallback is forbidden.

books.reason: RusSynodal has 12 source verses, while the app's Russian Prayer of Manasseh has 15 slots; no arbitrary verse splitting is permitted.
The official RusSynodal module does not contain 4 Maccabees.
RusSynodal has 70 verses in 2 Esdras 7, while the app has 140; the source does not cover every app verse slot.
RusSynodal integrates Greek Esther material into Esther; the app's standalone chapter model needs an audited internal versification map.
RusSynodal integrates this material into Daniel 3; an audited internal versification map is required before extraction.

sources.coveragePolicy: Complete Romans crosswalk. Every base and target coordinate is covered explicitly.
sources.mappingSource: CrossWire JSword Synodal-to-English-KJV versification table, inverted for the app's modern-base-to-Synodal direction and checked against both repository texts and pinned Synodal USFM.

sources.coveragePolicy: Whole native marker units in four independent structures must match exactly. Existing reviewed books and CrossWire exception chapters are excluded. Unlisted coordinates retain source edition; no a/b split.

sources.publisherCacheHashMethod: SHA-256 over sorted structure-root-relative POSIX path, NUL, exact file bytes, NUL for each JSON

sources.method: Same-coordinate identity only for complete native units untouched by existing exception rules; combined lines remain whole. Non-English base stories require fresh hash-bound rendered Bible.com parity. Text similarity is diagnostic, not a gate.
sources.targetAuthority: SHA-pinned traditional source archive and validated overlay
